projectDescription: PunctuOwlity is a browser-based event tracking app that lets you create, organize, and get reminders for upcoming events — converted from an original Android app and built to run entirely in your browser.
keyFeatures: Create, edit, and delete events with title, date, time, and category
Four event categories: All Events, Birthdays, Appointments, and Trips
Real-time search to filter events by title
Per-event reminder toggle with visible alarm-on / alarm-off status icons
Optional SMS notification preference at signup
Browser push notifications for same-day events (when SMS is allowed)
Secure account creation and login supporting username or email
Runs entirely in the browser — no server or backend required
Fully responsive two-column event grid across phone, tablet, and desktop
Persistent data storage using browser localStorage
publicApiSurface: Account signup (firstName, lastName, email, phone, username, password)
Login via username or email + password
Add event (title, date, time, reminder toggle)
Filter events by category: all | birthday | appointment | trip
